columns.name: MwSt enthalten
columns.reason: 'MwSt enthalten' = VAT included; all rows 'Nein' (no) → vat_included=false, explicit source evidence, not a retail assumption.

columns.name: Steuersatz
columns.reason: 'Steuersatz' = tax rate; single value '5%' in every row; fixture value. Parse percent to fraction 0.05 (explicit source rate, not inferred).

columns.name: Gültig ab (TT.MM.JJJJ)

Record dedupe now on /sku; sku uniqueness and product_name presence are enforced as quality rules.

Optional targets with no source evidence left empty instead of fabricated: /brand, /barcode, /category, /description, /status (schema default 'active' applies), /inventory, /promotions, /unit/pack_size, /prices/*/effective_to.
